# TL061 - Low-power JFET-input operational amplifier, single

Package DIP-8 · family TL06 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/TL061.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/TL061.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | NC1 | nc | NC in this revision of the datasheet |
| 2 | INMINUS | analog | inverting input (IN-) |
| 3 | INPLUS | analog | non-inverting input (IN+) |
| 4 | VCCMINUS | power | negative supply (VCC-) |
| 5 | NC5 | nc | NC in this revision of the datasheet |
| 6 | OUT | analog | output |
| 7 | VCCPLUS | power | positive supply (VCC+) |
| 8 | NC8 | nc | NC |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 6 | Operational amplifier: OUT is the amplified difference IN+ minus IN-. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Supply: +-18 V absolute maximum, +-5 V to +-15 V recommended. TL061C input offset voltage 3 typ / 15 max mV at 25 C; supply current 200 typ / 250 max uA (pages 5-6). |

## Not known

- Pins 1 and 5 are NC in revision N of the datasheet. The card wires pins 1 and 5 (they are in its reading); an older revision of the datasheet that might give them another use (such as offset null) was not read.

## Sources

- [TI TL06x low-power JFET-input operational amplifiers datasheet SLOS078N (November 1978, revised August 2023)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tl061.pdf) - 1, 4, 5, 6; TL061C
